$comment: Capture-time PII classification, read by evidence mode (npm run capture:evidence) only.
data_regions: every text inside a matching element takes the region's class —
P customer/member data, O organisation data, I operator identifier. Match by testid (exact),
testid_family (id suffix normalised, e.g. order-row-*), or role + name_regex.
Id-suffixed test ids and repeated list items are class P automatically even when not listed.
label_texts: exact application copy (case-insensitive) that is always class L (safe to publish).
Extend it from evidence/<app-id>/<run>/label-review.txt after review.
